body: Svalbard is a Norwegian archipelago in the Arctic Ocean. For country streak purposes, it is counted as Norway.
Licence plates in Svalbard are generally black with yellow text.
The landscape consists of barren, treeless mountains with sparse vegetation like moss and grasses. The coverage often has a gloomy, overcast sky.
Russian can sometimes be found on signs.
Longyearbyen, the largest settlement, has many boxy, minimalistic buildings.
Pyramiden feels abandoned, with multi-storey Soviet-style apartment blocks and a lack of human activity. The town is surrounded by pyramidal mountains.
Barentsburg is the most desolate town, featuring distinct, multi-coloured apartment blocks. The coverage is noticeably more overcast and gloomy.
The road southeast of Longyearbyen is recognizable by barren, treeless mountains on both sides, with lakes leading up to them. A small black mirror may be visible.
South of Svalbard Airport, a trekker in a red car can be seen on a winding road. A distinct line of mountains to the northeast is also a key indicator for this location.
This large ship provides coverage around the Northwest Spitsbergen National Park. Towards the east, the coverage becomes late in the day and eventually dark.
This boat with a wooden deck can be seen in these places.
This small red boat with men in red jackets on board can be seen in the northwest.
This boat with a black deck is visible in Isfjorden, between Barentsburg and Grumant.
This boat, seen east of Pyramiden, is identifiable by the slanted front of its wheelhouse.
